title: GrantTrace Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for GrantTrace authorization and mass-assignment auditing configuration.

$schema.description: URI pointing to this configuration schema

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this configuration environment

identities.description: Test identity credentials and roles (Owner, Visitor, and Anonymous)

parameter_values.description: Pre-configured valid path and query parameter values indexed by 'METHOD /path'

write_allowlist.description: List of PATCH operations permitted for active mass-assignment testing

readbacks.description: Independent GET readback mappings required for allowlisted PATCH operations

bopla.description: Explicit read-only field authorization policies. Operation sharing/public access does not override field restrictions; no inference from field names or OpenAPI readOnly.

bola.description: Per-operation BOLA exploration policies and resource ID path mappings

id.description: Resource identifier associated with this identity

token.description: Bearer token or Authorization header value

parameters.description: Identity-bound path or query parameters (e.g. user_id)

auth_header_names.description: Names of custom headers carrying authentication credentials

method.description: HTTP method for readback, must be GET

path.description: Path template for the readback operation

consistency.description: Readback consistency guarantee ('strong' required for unmutated SECURE conclusion)

field_map.description: Mapping from PATCH payload field path to readback response field path

parameters.description: Readback path/query Parameter Objects consumed directly by the URL builder

parameter_values.description: Explicit parameter values for the readback request

snapshot_path.description: Root path inside readback response containing the resource state

ignore_readback_paths.description: Known volatile fields (e.g. updatedAt) to ignore during rollback verification

readback_delay.description: Delay in seconds between readback polling attempts

baseline_payload.description: Additional static payload fields merged into write requests

baseline_representation.description: Operator attestation that the Owner response holds a complete private representation, not a mask.

value_is_resource_specific.description: Explicit operator attestation that the full private value identifies the selected resource; false or omitted cannot confirm leakage.

access.description: Explicit permissions for the configured identity/context; omitted low-privilege permissions remain unknown.

resource_binding.description: Exact JSON paths to operator-selected resource keys. All bindings must strictly match both Owner and a successful low-privilege response. Array fields require a same-item key; no automatic reordering.

expected_public.description: Whether this operation is intended to be publicly accessible

expected_visitor_access.description: Expected cross-resource access for ONLY the configured Visitor, Owner and resource pair. Use allow for a verified sharing/admin relationship; not a blanket endpoint exemption.

resource_id_paths.description: JSON field paths containing trustworthy resource ownership identifiers

private_data_paths.description: Exact scalar field paths in the selected Owner baseline whose concrete values the operator has verified are Owner-private and unauthorized for Anonymous. Visitor access defaults to deny; explicit pair sharing or required-role policy may authorize this Visitor. Required as positive evidence for new data-exposure detections. Numeric array indexes only, e.g. items[0].private_note; no wildcards. These paths do not establish state authority or freshness.

required_role.description: Explicit role required by this operation for the configured identity pair. Naming keywords and OpenAPI authentication schemes do not establish this role boundary.

owner_role.description: Operator-verified role of the configured Owner identity for this operation; must equal required_role to establish the privileged baseline.

visitor_role.description: Operator-verified role of the configured Visitor identity. Role comparison is exact, without inferring a role hierarchy.
